summary: Prioritized master checklist for all missing features in the TD Games Billing App. Organized into 3 tiers: 🔴 KHẨN CẤP (5 critical items with urgency notes), 🟡 QUAN TRỌNG (5 important items), 🟢 CẢI THIỆN (8 groups of nice-to-have improvements). Each item includes reasoning for its priority level.
